registryEntry.label: Create Outbound Spam Filter Rule for Primary Domain
registryEntry.set_command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; try { New-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule -Name 'CMMC-OutboundSpam-Rule' -HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy '{outboundSpamPolicyName}' -SenderDomainIs '{primaryDomain}' } catch { if ($_.Exception.Message -match 'already has rule') { Set-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule -Identity 'CMMC-OutboundSpam-Rule' -HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy '{outboundSpamPolicyName}' -SenderDomainIs '{primaryDomain}' } else { throw } }; Write-Output 'OK'
